title: John E. Amos Power Plant
scope: Standing John E. Amos plant exterior visible from the Kanawha River, with its three concrete cooling towers, four prominent mapped stacks and simplified generating building roofs.
limitations: The model depicts the dominant exterior skyline only. Roof polygons are approximate orthophoto readings with estimated eaves and roof top detail.
Cooling tower radius at grade follows the mapped circumference. Throat profile, wall colours, lower ribs, chimney details and proportions beyond published dimensions are approximate.
The model omits interior rooms, equipment, access infrastructure, minor ancillary buildings, steam, water and the wider industrial site.
